title: Maximum depth of a binary tree
description: Define a TreeNode class with val, left and right, then return the number of nodes along the longest path from the root down to a leaf. An empty tree has depth 0. The test helper builds trees from a level-order list using your TreeNode class, so it must accept TreeNode(val) with children defaulting to None.
hint: The depth of a node is one more than the deeper of its two subtrees, and the depth of None is zero. That is the whole recursion.
